human.description: Adaptable and resourceful, humans favor coin and connections over raw power.

elf.description: Quick and attuned to the world's currents, at the cost of a frailer frame.

dwarf.description: Stout and stubborn, built to shrug off blows that would fell others.

orc.description: Brutal strength wins fights fast, but leaves little room for finesse.

voidkin.description: Touched by the Shroud, they hit devastatingly hard but break easily.
